text:
olivia (oncall): ok folks — after yesterday's page I sketched a small pilot idea: capture handoff quicknotes automatically into a lightweight post-incident doc so we don't lose context during the 3am scramble. want feedback before I spin up a prototype.

james: yes please. the manual handoff notes today were all over google docs. we lost who owned the customer-impact assessment. :grimacing:

sahil: curious — how would this differ from the full postmortem generator we already have?

olivia (oncall): good q. this is intentionally minimal: an ephemeral doc created at first page with a schema: incident id, impacted customers (free-text + tags), observable timeline (bullet lines), immediate mitigation steps, current status, tentative action items (owner + ETA), and handoff checklist. the doc gets attached to the incident ticket and the postmortem later. no full analysis required during pager.

maya: makes sense. would the bot auto-populate any fields from the alert payload? e.g., region, error codes, service name?

olivia (oncall): yep — plan is best-effort enrich: service, region, initial error string, alert link, and top-k logs snippet (sanitized). owners can edit the doc in-thread.

oncall-bot: note — existing postmortem template v2 will still be used for the formal review. this pilot only produces the "quicknotes" artifact. :information_source:

james: will this create noise for non-actionable pages? we get a lot of infra blips that never require follow-ups.

olivia (oncall): we should gate creation on severity/paging-policy: only create when page severity >= P1 or when auto-escalation happens. also allow manual trigger with `/quicknotes start` for ambiguous pages.

sahil: can we include a compact action item dashboard view? like a single line per action: [owner] short title — ETA — status. makes it easy to triage follow-ups.

maya: yes! and we can push new actions to our existing remediation-tracker (GH issues). mapping would be: quicknote action -> create issue with label `post-incident-action` and link back.

olivia (oncall): prototype config snippet: ```yaml
# quicknotes-bot config
create_on: [P1, auto_escalation]
enrichment: [service, region, alert_text, top_logs]
auto_issue_label: post-incident-action
auto_issue_repo: infra/remediation
retention_days: 90
```

james: retention 90 days ok? some customers might need longer retention for compliance.

maya: we'll need to surface retention to non-oncall viewers and allow export to vault for enterprise. maybe `retention_days` becomes org-configurable.

sahil: also need to be careful about sensitive data in top_logs. we should either sanitize or capture only metadata + error hashes. don't want PII in ephemeral docs.

olivia (oncall): agreed. plan to sanitize via the logs-redactor service and drop any stacktraces longer than X lines. note: infra-bot can attach a link to sanitized logs instead of inline content.

infra-bot: action — redaction policy v1 applied: remove IPs, tokens, userids. long traces replaced with "[TRUNCATED]".

james: what about handoff responsibilities? we still need a one-line handoff summary pinned in the channel so oncoming oncall can scan quickly. can the bot create that?

olivia (oncall): yes — the bot posts a 2-line summary as the handoff message with link to quicknotes doc and current action list. format: `Handoff: <status> — <top-action-owner> (<ETA>) — <link>`.

maya: rollout plan? small pilot with SRE + infra for 2 weeks, collect feedback, then open to eng teams.

sahil: metrics to track: % pages with quicknotes, time from page -> doc created, fraction of actions auto-created in remediation repo, and rate of duplicate/noise docs.

james: can we add a tiny checkbox in the final postmortem template that says "Quicknotes artifact attached: yes/no" so reviewers know it existed?

olivia (oncall): yes — will add that field to the postmortem template.

oncall-bot: reminder — schedule created: quicknotes pilot kickoff tomorrow 10:00 PT.

deploy-bot: deployed quicknotes-bot v0.1 to staging at 2025-11-08T02:12:03Z.

maya: i'll draft the GH issue mapping + retention PR. assigning to @sahil for data redaction follow-up.

sahil: on it. i'll also add a flag so orgs with stricter policies can set `create_on` to manual-only.

james: small UX ask — allow `/quicknotes status <incident-id>` to get current action list and owners quickly.

olivia (oncall): noted. will add that command.

maya: +1 to adding the handoff message pin to the incident channel automatically. saves one more manual step.

oncall-bot: pinned message in #incidents: "Handoff summary for INC-2025-452".

olivia (oncall): thanks everyone. i'll put a short RFC in #eng-docs with links to the prototype repo and the staging bot, and we'll run the pilot next week. if anyone wants to help test late-night pages, DM me. :raised_hands:

james: thanks — excited to see less scattered notes. :tada:

sahil: quick follow-up: when pilot ends, can we export all quicknotes to the long-term postmortem repo? helps with audits.

maya: yes — add an export job in the pilot: nightly export of quicknotes marked `to_postmortem` to infra/postmortems.

olivia (oncall): added to roadmap.

oncall-bot: thread archived after 1 day of inactivity.
